Liquid Blade | Technical Lead (Fractional) | REMOTE | Success-Fee / Milestone-based

Assembling a small team for phased deployment of high-density GPU infrastructure. We have vertically integrated EPC/renewables and specialized construction partners already in place.

Current needs:

Validating site-specific power and thermal constraints.

Reviewing rack density assumptions (HGX/H100/H200).

Supporting technical discussions with colo and hardware vendors.

Advising on liquid cooling / CDU / RDHx deployment.

Ideal background: HGX/H100/H200 infrastructure, high-density colo deployments, liquid cooling, or thermal-power integration.

Terms: Open to fractional, advisory, or milestone-based structures. Compensation tied to execution milestones, not billable hours. We move on data.

Contact: tim@liquidblade.com
